title: Blam! Machinehead
overview:
Hallucinations! Through the eyes of Doctor Kimberley Stride, as you ride the 'Vorpal' and fly over this jumble of gunfire, strategic objectives and psycho melodramas worthy of the best B-movies.

Vertigo! In high-tech virtual landscapes (Eye Tech!...), dizzying tunnels and full-screen video.

Laughter! In the face of danger, as you burst with true existential joy in 3D across fifteen scenes, real adrenaline pumping stations.

Screams! Of terror before frightening hordes of polygonal mutants.

Mercy Begged! When you face the Cerebro virus in the lair of all confrontations...

Play! Blam! Machinehead! For THE ride of your life!!!
